cofinal_obstruction.scope: This is an obstruction to the fixed-N static absolute-tail proof method, not evidence of a common zero of the full Xi first jet.
cofinal_obstruction.theorem: For every fixed N and every static positive absolute tail bar epsilon_0, the value-or-derivative direct-bar certificate fails at some point of every sufficiently large S_j.

required_upgrade.open_target: Construct a uniform cancellation-aware first-jet remainder theorem strong enough to close every S_j without assuming zero simplicity or RH.
required_upgrade.route: A cofinal theta-shell proof must let N grow with x, replace static moment bars by oscillatory remainder bounds that retain endpoint-jet cancellation, or use a modular grouping that preserves the cancellation before transformation.

static_tail_certificate.failure: For every x>X_N and every 0<=t<=1/5, |J_(N,t)(x)|<E_0(x) and |J_(N,t)'(x)|<E_1(x)

two_block_boundary_cancellation.full_cancellation: Phi is even, so (exp(tu^2)Phi(u))'(0)=0 and sum_(n>=3)phi_n'(0)=-a_2<0
two_block_boundary_cancellation.interpretation: The omitted theta tail cancels the algebraic x^(-2) endpoint term of the retained two-block transform. Static absolute moments discard this cancellation.
two_block_boundary_cancellation.sign_proof: For n>=3, 4*pi*n^2-15>0, hence -8*pi^2*n^4+30*pi*n^2-15<0. The differentiated theta series converges locally uniformly. Since Phi is even, sum_(n>=1)phi_n'(0)=0, so a_2=-sum_(n>=3)phi_n'(0)>0.

proof_boundary: This artifact proves that a fixed finite theta truncation combined with fixed positive static absolute-moment tail bars cannot certify the cofinal diagonal shell family. It also identifies the exact endpoint cancellation discarded by the two-block bars. It does not prove a common zero, disprove the finite interval certificates, certify any new Q_j, prove Lambda<=0, prove RH, or win a Clay prize.
